readings: For each distinct invoice number in `Invoice_Line_Items`, divide the sum of its non-null `derived_product_cost` values by the sum of its non-null `derived_total_cost` values to get the invoice ratio. Also show the count of all its line-item rows and the invoice ratio divided by the arithmetic mean of defined invoice ratios across all invoices. Treat a ratio as missing if its denominator is zero or either required sum is missing; omit missing invoice ratios from the overall mean. Return rows only if that mean exists. If the mean is zero, the relative figure is missing. Sort by the relative figure descending, with missing figures last; return the first 10 rows without rounding.

For each distinct invoice number in `Invoice_Line_Items`, calculate `derived_product_cost` divided by `derived_total_cost` for each line item with both values present and a nonzero total cost, then take the arithmetic mean of those line-item ratios as the invoice ratio. Also show the count of all its line-item rows and the invoice ratio divided by the arithmetic mean of defined invoice ratios across all invoices. Treat an invoice ratio as missing if it has no eligible line items, and omit missing invoice ratios from the overall mean. Return rows only if that mean exists. If the mean is zero, the relative figure is missing. Sort by the relative figure descending, with missing figures last; return the first 10 rows without rounding.
queries:
WITH invoice_sums AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count,
    SUM(derived_product_cost) AS product_sum,
    SUM(derived_total_cost) AS total_sum
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
invoice_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    line_item_count,
    CASE
      WHEN product_sum IS NOT NULL AND total_sum IS NOT NULL AND total_sum <> 0
      THEN 1.0 * product_sum / total_sum
    END AS invoice_ratio
  FROM invoice_sums
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS mean_ratio
  FROM invoice_ratios
)
SELECT
  r.invoice_number,
  r.invoice_ratio,
  r.line_item_count,
  CASE
    WHEN m.mean_ratio <> 0 THEN r.invoice_ratio / m.mean_ratio
  END AS relative_ratio
FROM invoice_ratios AS r
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
WHERE m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        COUNT(*) AS line_item_count,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
                 AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
                 AND derived_total_cost <> 0
                THEN CAST(derived_product_cost AS REAL) / derived_total_cost
            END
        ) AS invoice_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS mean_invoice_ratio
    FROM invoice_ratios
)
SELECT
    invoice_number,
    line_item_count,
    invoice_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN mean_invoice_ratio <> 0
        THEN invoice_ratio / mean_invoice_ratio
    END AS relative_figure
FROM invoice_ratios
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE mean_invoice_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_figure IS NULL, relative_figure DESC
LIMIT 10
